verdict.rationale: Oneleet's Fieldwork page says its AI agents collect, validate, and package evidence across enterprise systems on a schedule. The docs also describe monitoring integrations for AWS, GitHub, and Google Workspace. However, the scheduled collection claim is a single marketing line, and the docs do not show integration monitoring output becoming audit evidence or artifacts being timestamped. missing for 10: documented recurring collection cadence per integration, timestamped artifact format/provenance, explicit mapping of integration data to control evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security engineer, evidence is collected automatically from connected systems on a schedule — screenshots and CSV exports are replaced by timestamped, machine-gathered artifacts

citations.quote: Fieldwork’s AI agents collect, validate, and package the evidence – across your enterprise systems, on your schedule.
Oneleet currently monitors the following AWS resources: Accounts, RDS instances, Application and Classic load balancers, IAM users
Oneleet currently monitors the following on Google Workspace: User accounts, GMail settings
